title: Sample-based quantum simulation of vibrational structure of polyyne chains
summary: Predicting anharmonic vibrational spectra is a complex computational task, which becomes quickly infeasible as molecular size and the number of vibrational basis functions increase, leading to an exponential growth of the underlying Hilbert space. Here, we employ a sample-based quantum diagonalization (SQD) framework to compute anharmonic vibrational energies and spectra.
